description.zh: 云手机镜像ID，若不指定，则按当前实例的镜像进行重置。
description.en: The cloud phone image ID. If this parameter is not specified, the instance is reset by using its current image.

description.zh: 云手机实例ID列表，N取值范围1-100
description.en: The list of cloud phone instance IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

调用该接口时，您需要注意：
- 云手机实例的状态必须为已停止（Stopped）。
- 若创建云手机实例的源镜像被删除，则无法初始化。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description

When you call this operation, take note of the following items:
- The cloud phone instance must be in the Stopped state.
- If the source image used to create the cloud phone instance has been deleted, the instance cannot be initialized.
